remarks:
Tucked along an amazing residential block on Buffalo’s East Side, 248 Adams Street offers a blank canvas for new construction and creative redevelopment. Measuring approximately 30 x 110 feet (.0751 acres), this parcel provides an ideal footprint for a single-family home, infill development, or a thoughtfully designed urban garden space.

Surrounded by established homes and ongoing neighborhood investment, the lot presents an opportunity to shape something new while contributing to the continued revitalization of the area. Whether envisioned as a new residence, green space, or part of a broader redevelopment plan, this property offers flexibility and long-term potential.

This property can also be purchased as part of a larger assemblage including nine lots on Peckham Street totaling approximately 0.91 acres (MLS#:B1665930) , a 27,806 sq feet church with school on .52 acres at 300 Adams st (MLS# B1665688), and the parsonage duplex at 308 Adams Street (MLS#B1665682).  The combined properties offer expanded development potential and flexibility for a larger project footprint. 

Equal Housing Opportunity.
